barWidget.description: GPU / CPU (llvmpipe) rasterizer switch for the bar and menu

description: GPU/CPU rasterizer switch for the Omarchy shell: render the bar and menu on the GPU or on the CPU via Mesa/llvmpipe. Useful while the GPU is saturated (e.g. by local inference) and driver resource exhaustion would otherwise corrupt the shell's GL state. The button shows the configured backend; switching persists it and offers a shell restart, since the backend applies at shell start.
name: Shell Render Switch
